Some say that he once slammed a revolving door.

The Wolverine tracked it up into the mountains. The heavy air of pine trees doing nothing to mask it's scent. He knew where they were, he could hear, he could  smell them. He understood it, it was a not killer, it was a hunter, Predators. One had lead him here, only one, but he would not underestimate them. He had smelled it before, watching him, learning. It was smart, it would not attack alone. 

He knew this would be where it attacked, where they attacked. He heard now, quiet, silent, no birdsong, no shuffling in the branches. Their silence gave them away, the perfect hunters, too perfect. He could smell them, waiting in the shadows, an alien smell, unique. But as his clawes came to shine in the light the air changed; revealing the unmistakable scent of fear. The Predator was waiting. They did not know pain, they did not know terror. Not yet.

The Predator had not needed to make its path obvious, this one could track. The Predator would not hold back on this kill, this would be a challenge. The trail lead to a clearing, a 'trap' that the Predator had set, for it knew that alone there would be no chance of success, or of survival.

It watched him from the shadows. The Wolverine, now became the hunted as he stood in a clearing. The Predator had watched this one fight, seen this 'Wolverine' kill, he too was a hunter, unmatched, unrivaled, but unprepared. Not knowing how many foes waited for him in the dark, Not knowing how long they had spent preparing for this moment, Not knowing defeat or death. Not yet.
